creation.prompt: Edit reference 1 for the requested local body correction. Reference 2 owns identity/anatomy; reference 3 contains measurement guides. Preserve the approved Milo canonical identity, lean grey felt anatomy, cream muzzle and belly boundaries, moss-green eyes, orange tail, canonical ears, eyes and paw construction. Short readable neck; no enlarged head, wide belly, shortened limbs or independently scaled body parts. Canonical upright projected head fraction 0.39 +/-0.01 applies only at comparable upright angle/support, never crouch or tumble. Use annotated visible-surface width, cream patch and paw references at comparable views, not hidden-joint guesses. Do not render annotations. Mouth closed, no teeth, no speech mouth. Genuine transparent alpha, neutral soft light, no background, ground plane, props, labels or shadows. Exactly one candidate; no variants. Repair the image-left leg: visible continuous attachment through hip and thigh into knee, shin, ankle and paw, no floating/disconnected segment. Preserve the stumbling rear-paw-contact action, canonical limb construction and other body geometry. Alarmed raised brows, wide eyes and tense closed muzzle, no smile. Full character with margins; Leo obstacle is implied, not drawn.

inputs.authority: acting_reference_only; no anatomy authority or approval transfer
